tools.name: generate_math_cages
tools.description: Use this when the user wants printable math cage puzzles (arithmetic cage puzzles, calculation sudoku-style grids with cages, math logic puzzles for a class) as a PDF with an answer key. Each grid from 4 x 4 to 9 x 9 uses the numbers 1 to N once per row and column; each cage shows a target and a sig
